config.aishulkersorter.auto_label.toolti: Automatically rename shulker boxes after sorting (e.g. 'Blocks #1', 'Ores #2')
config.aishulkersorter.include_loose_ite: Let AI keep or sort loose inventory items (enabled by default)
When enabled, empty shulker boxes are ignored during sorting and left untouched in your inventory.
config.aishulkersorter.overflow_mode.too:
What happens when there are more items than shulker box slots available.

Fill: Boxes are filled across categories until full — mixed content is allowed when space is tight. Remaining items stay in inventory.

Dominant: Each box is dedicated to one category only. Only the top categories (by item count) are sorted; items from other categories stay in inventory.
config.aishulkersorter.loose_item_ignore: Items with this text in their name will not be sorted into shulker boxes (e.g. rename an item to '[KEEP] Diamond Sword')
config.aishulkersorter.locked_tag.toolti: Shulker boxes with this text in their name will be skipped during sorting
config.aishulkersorter.tooltip_enabled.t: Show shulker box contents when hovering over them
config.aishulkersorter.tooltip_max_lines: Maximum number of item lines shown in the tooltip (1-27)
config.aishulkersorter.enable_chat_notif: Show chat messages when sorting completes or fails
config.aishulkersorter.enable_sound_effe: Play a sound when sorting completes successfully
config.aishulkersorter.enable_hud_overla: Show an animated 'Sorting...' overlay on the HUD during sorting
config.aishulkersorter.category_order.to: Order in which categories are matched during sorting. Items are matched top-to-bottom; the first match wins.
Disabled categories are skipped during sorting. Their items fall through to Misc.
config.aishulkersorter.category.patterns: Item ID patterns for this category. Prefix: 'raw_' (items starting with raw_). Suffix: '_planks' (items ending with _planks). Exact or substring: 'redstone'.
